text: Transportation staff had reviewed the need for traffic calming, specifically speed humps, on Wychwood Avenue, between St. Clair Avenue West and Helena Avenue, to address the residents' concerns regarding vehicles speeds. The assessment indicated that the criteria as set out in the traffic calming policy had not been satisfied and that the installation of humps would be problematic due to the concrete streetcar track bed.

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Re-opened Item TE26.109 entitled "Traffic Calming (Speed Humps) – Wychwood Avenue", with respect to Recommendation 1. 2. Deleted Recommendation 1 of Item TE26.109 and replaced it with the following new Recommendation: "1. The Acting Director, Transportation Services, Toronto and East York District investigate options for traffic calming between St. Clair Avenue West and Helena Avenue, including possible removal of the existing decommissioned streetcar tracks to allow for the installation of speed humps, and report back to Toronto and East York Community Council on that investigation with a recommended traffic calming plan. Following the report back to Toronto and East York Community Council, the Acting Director, Transportation Services, Toronto and East York District request the City Clerk to poll eligible householders on Wychwood Avenue,…
